bundle.shortDescription: A desktop cockpit for AI-assisted coding
bundle.longDescription: Luxor is an open-source desktop cockpit for AI-assisted coding: real multi-terminals with savable layouts, project tabs, a full Git explorer and quick actions.

updater.//: Disabled until release signing keys exist. Before re-enabling: run `tauri signer generate`, put the public key in `pubkey`, and keep the private key in CI secrets. Never ship `active: true` with an empty pubkey — that is an unsigned update channel.
